name: sudo runs one command as root or as another user
lines: sudo -u mira whoami; sudo -u mira id; sudo --user=mira whoami; sudo -uroot whoami
cd /tmp && sudo touch r && sudo -u mira touch m && sudo mkdir rd && ls -l r m && ls -ld rd

name: the shell opens redirections before sudo runs; tee writes as root
lines: echo x | sudo tee /etc/f; echo s=$?

name: sudo cannot run builtins or unknown commands
sudo -l lists what you may run
lines: sudo -l whoami; sudo -l nosuch; echo s=$?

name: as root, chown gives files away
lines: sudo chown mira readme.txt; ls -l readme.txt
sudo chown -R mira:smiths forest; ls -l forest forest/cave
sudo chown -c hero: readme.txt; ls -l readme.txt
